unfilled_seats_note: 136 seats under the representation norm; 134 filled: the act deploys 2 of the national-stage seats of PARTIDUL OAMENILOR TINERI to no constituency, so slots stay unfilled in GIURGIU (1) and IALOMIȚA (1); the act states no reason. Inter-Parliamentary Union, IPU Parline, a secondary source read on 2026-11-20, explains: POT was to obtain nine Senate seats but had too few candidates in the constituencies where two of them were to be filled; the Central Electoral Bureau left those two seats vacant, so the 2024 Senate has 134 members against a statutory 136. No Central Electoral Bureau decision on the vacancy was read.
